title: Xcode and Swift builds
notes: xcodebuild needs OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS='$(inherited) -disable-sandbox' for code that uses Swift macros such as @State, and swift build needs --disable-sandbox: neither can start a sandbox of its own inside this one.
Not covered: a project with Swift packages built by xcodebuild, a target with an Icon Composer icon, running tests, a simulator, and signing with a certificate. Each needs more than folders.

recorded.by: hand, checked with sandbox-discover and a build under replay's sandbox rules
